recommendation: Promote this exact matrix-storage-FP16 / FP32-arithmetic encoder plus native WebGPU Asyncify runtime to final worker feasibility validation. All nine unchanged tensor gates pass with identical top-five ordering, all 875 optimized nodes are placed on GPU, and actual emitted Gemm/MatMul accumulators are FP32. This main-thread diagnostic does not replace full image-pipeline, worker, full-catalog, memory, installation or offline reload acceptance checks.
